//: Root Directory in the Vercel dashboard must stay EMPTY (the repository
root). Setting it to `client` hides api/ and server/ from the build, so no
serverless function is produced: the front-end deploys perfectly and every
The commands below therefore address the repo root, not the client folder.
Vercel shows them greyed out in the dashboard because this file owns them —
that is expected, and editing them there instead would drift from the repo.
installCommand: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

//: Only the Linux query engine is force-included. Vercel traces static
requires on its own, so node_modules must not be listed: server/
node_modules is 476 MB against a 250 MB per-function limit, and a broad
glob fails at packaging rather than at runtime.
Prisma loads this engine dynamically at the first query, so the tracer
cannot see it. Omit it and the build succeeds while every request dies
on 'Query engine library not found' — green and broken.
